title: fix(post): block cutting tools at reserved numbers and names
body:
Stacked on #3157 (merge #3157 first)

## What changed

Machine files accept `tooling.reserved` entries.
Each entry reserves a number, a name, or both for `probe` or `tool_setter`.
The reader and validator refuse malformed entries by key.
Stored projects retain the reservations.

New cutting tools skip reserved numbers.
A probe takes a declared probe pocket.
Tool edits and library imports refuse incompatible reserved numbers or names.
Verification and posting also refuse old unsafe assignments.
The existing GUI, script, and MCP commands use these checks.
Tool number zero remains refused.

The standalone post CLI checks its input before it creates or replaces output.
It retains the loaded tool across sections.
A new TOOL needs its own declared kind.
A stream with no tool selector cannot post motion on a machine with reservations.
Indexed lookups keep the checks bounded for long streams.

The 18 shipped Tormach mill and router files reserve T99 for the probe.
A machine that omits the field reserves nothing.

## Cause

Tool allocation considered only document numbers.
Machine files could not protect a probe pocket or a control-managed tool name.
The app and standalone post paths had no reservation check.

## Before and after screenshots

These captures are reused from parent #3157.
Both captures use the seeded shell at 1280 × 720 with the HAAS VF-2 machine file mounted.
The camera looks from the front, and the work envelope is shown.
The before capture has "Show operator side" off.
The after capture has the switch on and shows the viewport marker.

## Tests

### Author-side verification — 2026-11-22

Final head: `757c65cf48a448be98bced1d5565e702e039b622`.
Base at the start of verification: `upstream/main` at `03e05a64991301417bfd17c766fa512c1440950a`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 150 steps.
The tests reported 2,904 passed, zero failed, and nine ignored.
No step failed. The run took 11.4 minutes.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 198 steps.
The tests reported 43 passed and four registered known failures.
The gate confirmed all four expected failures. No unexpected failure occurred.
The run took 31.9 minutes.
The change to `crates/app/src/commands/tool.rs` reaches all app heavy targets.
The unchanged final head selects 198 steps. The review trial merge selected 203 steps.

The gate checked these registered known failures and confirmed their expected failures:

- #1950: `the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`.
- #2849: `fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works`.
- #2849: `an_axis_aligned_lead_start_posts_the_users_arc_entry_as_g18_or_g19`.
- #2849: `the_horizontal_arc_entry_on_the_users_pocket_verifies_silent`.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
The run took 1 minute 28 seconds.

### Original author test record

All 31 pins pass.
The 26 defect and new-data checks failed at runtime before their fixes.

```text
cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main
cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings
```

The original author quick gate passed all 150 steps in 4.7 minutes.
Strict all-target Clippy passed for both changed crates.

The import mutation uses the stack-parent module because upstream changed its file layout.
The whole upstream parser needs newer machine fields.
Its compile failure does not count as a red pin.
The runtime parser mutation removes the reservation assignment.

## Goldens moved

One saved-project fixture changes: `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj`.
It adds only the stored T99 reservation.
The exact project comparison stays enabled.

This issue changes no NC or CL files.
All 53 NC/CL differences in the direct upstream comparison already exist in the older stack parent.

## Not exercised

- Physical machines, tool changers, or controller sessions.
- Named tool-call execution on a Siemens control.
- Full release tier and pixel snapshot lanes.

The existing Sinumerik post uses numeric calls.
This change validates reserved names and leaves controller syntax to the post.

## Overlaps

- #3157 changes `parse_mch_with` and `Machine`. This branch starts at `4e93e1831`.
- #3160, #3058, and #3057 touch `crates/app/src/lib.rs` at other module declarations. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #3251 changes the version field in the same project fixture. This issue changes its machine reservation field. Whichever merges second refreshes.

Effort: high

Changelog: Cutting tools skip reserved probe pockets and cannot use reserved tool names.

Fixes #2604
